newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Coelce still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Coelce still a buy.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming Inc said it has reiterated its buy recommendation on shares of Brazilian state electric firm Companhias Energeticas do Ceara, known as Coelce,.
-- Coelce is owned by the northeastern state of Ceara.
-- Fleming cited Coelce's steadily improving financial results and the high price paid last week by a Chilean-led group when it bought state power firm Cerj.
-- Coelce, one of Brazil's fastest-growing utilities, is 25 percent smaller than Cerj, has lower energy losses and plans to invest $150 million through next year, the brokerage said in a report.
-- Ceara is likely to privatize part or all of the firm in late 1997 or early 1998, it said.
-- Fleming said Coelce shares have soared 87.6 percent in U.S. dollar terms since it issued its initial buy rating on September 9.
-- "This performance has stimulated more active trading in the stock as daily traded volumes have improved," it added.
-- Coelce preferred, which closed Wednesday at 1.71 reais, was untrading at 1200 local/1400 gmt in Sao Paulo. Its voting common also was untraded, after closing Tuesday at 2.00 reais.
